blocking_findings.finding: At the observed development rates P=6/6 and R=3/6 on independent clusters, the frozen v7 adverse primary-label transformation approaches P=0.6096 and R=0.5922, a +0.0174 difference that cannot clear the +0.15 worthwhile threshold merely by collecting more responses at the same rates.
blocking_findings.interpretation: This pilot-informed feasibility calculation is not an effect estimate, power result, or confirmatory outcome. It shows that the current finite judge-validation uncertainty is an endpoint threat.
blocking_findings.required_action: Prospectively freeze a bounded extension using the unchanged Luna-v7 model, prompt, schema, and rules on fresh endpoint-focused references. Preserve all existing qualification results; do not tune labels or thresholds.
